messages:
sam_cs: Quick async standup for NorthStar renewal -> adoption blockers.

sam_cs: What I did: followed up with NorthStar CSM, ran onboarding job for embeddings, verified token usage report; escalated retention metric to eng.

sam_cs: Blockers: webhook retries are spiking for their staging org, sync failures ~14% (noticed after yesterday's prod sweep). They say renewals call is next week and are worried about false negatives in similarity searches.

sam_cs: Today: need an eng sanity-check on webhook retry policy + embeddings scoring threshold; also want to run a quick A/B on kv-cache TTL. @aj_wong can you look when you have 30m?

maria_ramirez: +1. Please also include the customer's sample payloads — I left them in the ticket (TKT-4382). If we can show <1% error after fix that's great for renewal pitch. :thumbsup:

aj_wong: On it, I can repro the retry storm locally with their payloads. Quick ask: can you paste a sample curl I can run against staging? saves time.

sam_cs: paste below — it's the minimal repro we used:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-webhooks.redwood-inference.com/northstar -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"user_id":"u123","embedding": [0.01,0.23,...], "event":"upsert"}'
```

sam_cs: also note they use short TTL for KV cache which may be causing more upstream calls; suggested bump from 60s -> 300s for test.

aj_wong: thanks — running now. If it's the retry window we can tighten debounce to 5s and add a cap. Will post results in 30.

devon_p: for renewals FYI: if we get this under control quick, we can offer a one-month dedicated capacity trial and highlight the lower latencies. signal that in renewal deck.

ingest-bot: webhook-delivery-alert: 2024-09-04T09:12:14Z — northstar-staging org: delivery failure rate 13.9% (last 1h)

aj_wong: Repro confirmed — bug in backoff calculation when downstream responds 429 plus intermittent 5xx. I pushed a small fix to staging branch `hotfix/webhook-backoff` and triggered a deploy.

aj_wong: After deploy: failure rate down to 2.1% in staging over 15min window. Will open PR and request review from eng-runtime. cc @maria_ramirez

maria_ramirez: Excellent. Sam, can you schedule a quick sync with the customer to validate? I'll update the renewal notes.

sam_cs: scheduled a 20m call at 11:30 PT. Thanks all. If numbers hold post-deploy I'll mark as green for renewal.

aj_wong: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4512 — minor backoff math + test. Ping @eng-runtime for quick review.

sam_cs: closing loop here — will post customer confirmation after call. :white_check_mark:
